messages:
Nora Kim: Heads-up: small scope update to the parental leave / handbook crosswalk. We're adding an "intermittent return" subsection and a short manager checklist. Need approvals by EOD Friday.
Ollie James: Can the checklist include payroll steps? Last-minute payroll misses caused delays for one return last quarter.
Nora Kim: Yes adding payroll step + people-ops contact + template email.
Priya Sharma: Will employees on intermittent return still be assigned mandatory trainings? Some start mid-cycle and missed prior modules.
Jill (Legal): They should receive role-appropriate mandatory trainings but can be assigned to a deferred cohort with manager approval. Add exception request to HR casework.
Samir Lee: @peopleops-bot can you add the deferred cohort flag to the Parental Leave workflow?
peopleops-bot: Deferred cohort flag added to casework flow. ETA deploy 2h.
Nora Kim: Great. I'll update the handbook appendix and notify managers.
Ollie James: Approving the payroll checklist.
Priya Sharma: Approving the deferred cohort approach.
Jill (Legal): Approved legal wording for intermittent return subsection.
Nora Kim: Thanks team. I'll publish and run a short all-managers digest.
